meta.name: nextjs-developer
meta.description: Use when building Next.js 14+ applications with App Router, server components, or server actions. Invoke to configure route handlers, implement middleware, set up API routes, add streaming SSR, write generateMetadata for SEO, scaffold loading.tsx/error.tsx boundaries, or deploy to Vercel. Triggers on: Next.js, Next.js 14, App Router, RSC, use server, Server Components, Server Actions, React Server Components, generateMetadata, loading.tsx, Next.js deployment, Vercel, Next.js performance.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Next.js 14+ 规范编写代码:使用 App Router,默认服务器组件,必要时才加 'use client';自动生成 SEO 元数据、图片优化、加载/错误页面,并在部署前检查构建是否通过。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Next.js 14、App Router、Server Actions 等关键词,或要求配置路由、实现中间件、部署到 Vercel 等场景时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我用 App Router 创建一个带加载页的商品列表页面。
say.note: Claude 会生成路由、加载组件和数据获取代码。

say.text: 给这个 Next.js 项目加一个服务器操作来处理表单提交并刷新页面。
为这个页面写 generateMetadata 设置 SEO 标题和描述。
say.note: Claude 会生成动态元数据代码。

howto.what_en: Claude writes Next.js 14+ code using App Router, prefers server components, adds 'use client' only when needed, generates SEO metadata, optimizes images, adds loading/error boundaries, and checks the build before deployment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Next.js 14, App Router, Server Actions, or similar keywords, or asks to configure routes, implement middleware, or deploy to Vercel.

say_en.text: Create a product list page with App Router and a loading state.
say_en.note: Claude generates route, loading component, and data fetching code.

say_en.text: Add a server action to handle form submission and refresh the page.
say_en.note: Claude implements the Server Action and calls revalidatePath.

say_en.text: Write generateMetadata for this page with SEO title and description.
